newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algerians start voting in general election.
newsitem.headline: Algerians start voting in general election.

text.p: Algerians began voting on Thursday in the first parliamentary election after five years of violence and bloodshed, witnesses said.

Security was tight as most polling stations in Algiers opened at 8 a.m. (0700 GMT) and voters began casting ballots to elect a 380-member National Assembly (lower house) from among more than 7,000 candidates representing 39 political parties.
The election comes after a wave of attacks by suspected Moslem rebels in the capital in which 22 people were killed.

The authorities say the poll is a key step towards ending civil strife that began in January 1992 when the army-backed government cancelled elections radical Islamists were poised to win. About 60,000 people have died in the conflict.
